provider.description: The provider's name, for a reader of the output.

models.description: One entry per model the page publishes a price for.

model_name.description: The API's own name for the model.

cost_input.description: USD per million input tokens; the shorthand for an 'in' rule.

cost_output.description: USD per million output tokens; the shorthand for an 'out' rule.

price.description: Rule name to rule, in dic's price-table shape.  A rule name is a usage name ('in', 'out', 'in.cache_read', 'in.cache_write.5m', 'out.reasoning') or a refinement of one ('in.long', 'in.flex').

rate.description: USD per unit; per million tokens for the default unit.

key.description: The usage name this rule prices, when the rule's own name is a refinement of it.

tier.description: The service tier this rule applies to.

when.description: A python expression over in_total, out_total and tier; e.g. 'in_total > 272000'.

unit.description: What one of the quantity is; defaults to token, quoted per million.

quote_in.description: The exact text the input rate was read from.

quote_out.description: The exact text the output rate was read from.
